keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «나비의 한살이는 알·애벌레·번데기·어른벌레의 네 단계다(주제)» 와 «메리안의 꼼꼼한 관찰은 나비가 진흙이 아니라 놀라운 변화를 거쳐 자란다는 것을 밝혔다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the topic (a butterfly’s life has four stages) and the conclusion (Merian’s careful observation proved that butterflies grow through amazing changes, not out of mud). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Insects grow through changes, not out of mud

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.

qs.q: Why does a female butterfly lay her eggs on a certain plant?
qs.qko: 암컷 나비가 특정한 식물에 알을 낳는 이유는 무엇인가요?
opts: Because her young can eat that plant
Because the plant hides her from birds
Because the plant keeps the eggs warm
evs: A female lays tiny eggs on a plant that her young can eat.
She collected caterpillars, fed them leaves, and watched them carefully every day.
Then it forms a hard case around itself, which is called a chrysalis.
At the age of 52, she even sailed to South America to study insects there.
why: 암컷은 새끼(애벌레)가 먹을 수 있는 식물에 아주 작은 알을 낳는다고 했어요.
A female lays tiny eggs on a plant that her young can eat.

qs.q: In "The caterpillar that hatches eats almost nonstop," what does "nonstop" mean?
qs.qko: «The caterpillar that hatches eats almost nonstop» 에서 «nonstop» 은 무슨 뜻인가요?
evs: The caterpillar that hatches eats almost nonstop and sheds its skin several times as it grows.
This complete change is called metamorphosis.
At the age of 52, she even sailed to South America to study insects there.
why: 애벌레는 자라면서 허물을 여러 번 벗을 만큼 많이 먹어요. «non(아닌) + stop(멈추다)» 이니 «멈추지 않고 계속» 이라는 뜻이에요.
The caterpillar grows so fast that it sheds its skin several times. «Non» + «stop» means without stopping.

qs.q: Why is the chrysalis stage more amazing than it looks?
qs.qko: 번데기 단계가 보기보다 놀라운 이유는 무엇인가요?
opts: It looks quiet outside, but inside the body is rebuilt into wings, legs, and new eyes
The chrysalis moves around and eats leaves all day
The butterfly flies out of the egg right away
evs: From the outside, the chrysalis looks quiet, as if nothing is happening.
The caterpillar that hatches eats almost nonstop and sheds its skin several times as it grows.
Inside, however, the caterpillar's body breaks down and is rebuilt into wings, legs, and new eyes.
A young German artist named Maria Sibylla Merian did not believe it.
why: 겉으로 보면 번데기는 조용해서 아무 일도 없는 것 같지만, 안에서는 몸이 날개·다리·새 눈으로 다시 만들어진다고 했어요. 두 문장을 이어야 해요.
From the outside, the chrysalis looks quiet, but inside, the body is rebuilt into wings, legs, and new eyes. You need both sentences.

ends: Why do monarch butterflies fly thousands of kilometers every year?
왜 제왕나비는 해마다 수천 킬로미터를 날아갈까요?
How does a tadpole change into a frog?

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «함께 할 일 + 그보다 나중에 일어날 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what we should do together and what happens after that.

write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «before» 뒤에 «무엇이 + 어떻게 되는지» 를 넣어 때를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: before the flowers close)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «before», write what + what happens to make the time clear. (e.g. before the flowers close)
